FX-GRAD-001.says: The settings as they start: linear from the top middle to the bottom middle, white at 0 per cent to #6450a0 at 50, multiply. Row 1, the line along the top, is barely touched, and each row down is darker and more violet, the bottom most; every pixel in a row is changed alike, and the empty pixels stay empty.

FX-GRAD-002.says: Blend normal, both opacities 100: the cel is painted over with the gradient itself, white fading down to #6450a0, the line and the shadow gone under it, each pixel at its own covering.

FX-GRAD-003.says: Blend screen, white to #6450a0, both opacities 100: every pixel that shows is lightened, and none darkened.

FX-GRAD-004.says: Blend add, #000000 to #6450a0, 0 to 50 per cent: the violet is added, nothing at the top and most at the bottom; no channel passes the pixel's covering.

FX-GRAD-005.says: Radial, from the middle, 50, 50, to the middle of the right edge, 100, 50, blend normal at 100: the colour runs in rings about the middle, and everything eight pixels or further from it is #6450a0.

FX-GRAD-006.says: Start and end the same point, 50, 50: t is 1 everywhere, so, blend normal at 100, every pixel that shows is #6450a0 at its own covering.

FX-GRAD-007.says: Linear, left to right, 0, 50 to 100, 50, blend normal at 100: the colour runs across the columns, every pixel in a column alike.

FX-GRAD-008.says: Both points outside the drawing, 50, -100 and 50, 200, blend normal at 100: the drawing sees only the middle third of the gradient, t from 11.5/30 in row 1, the line along its top, to 18.5/30 in row 8.

FX-GRAD-009.says: Both points past the bottom, 50, 150 and 50, 200, blend normal at 100: every pixel is before the start, t is 0, and the cel is all white.

FX-GRAD-010.says: The start point keyed from 50, 0 at frame 0 to 50, 100 at frame 4, the end 50, 100, blend normal at 100, linear: frame 0 is FX-GRAD-002; frame 2 starts at the middle row, so rows 0 to 4 are white; frame 4 has start and end the same, and is FX-GRAD-006.

FX-GRAD-011.says: Start opacity keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, end opacity from 50 to 0: frame 0 is FX-GRAD-001, frame 2 is 50 to 25, frame 4 is 100 to 0, the top now most touched and the bottom row barely.

FX-GRAD-013.says: White to white, blend normal at 100: every pixel that shows turns white at its own covering, the half-covering edge white at half covering, and the empty pixels stay empty.

FX-GRAD-014.says: FX-GRAD-001 with its colours written in capitals: the same.

FX-GRAD-015.says: FX-GRAD-001 moved three pixels right: the same, moved; the gradient moves with the drawing.

FX-GRAD-023.says: Ramp Scatter 64 on FX-GRAD-002 (normal, both opacities 100): the ramp grained, each pixel's place along it moved by up to an eighth of the ramp either way, fixed to the drawing; pixels in one row no longer all alike.

FX-GRAD-024.says: Ramp Scatter 0 and Blend With Original 0 written: FX-GRAD-002 exactly.

FX-GRAD-025.says: Blend With Original 50 on FX-GRAD-002: every pixel halfway between the drawing and FX-GRAD-002's.

FX-GRAD-026.says: Blend With Original 100: the drawing, untouched.

FX-GRAD-027.says: Ramp Scatter keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 256 at frame 4: frame 0 is FX-GRAD-002, frame 2 scatter 128, frame 4 the most, half the ramp either way.

FX-GRAD-028.says: FX-GRAD-023 moved three pixels right: the grain is fixed to the drawing, so it moves with it.

FX-GRAD-029.says: Ramp Scatter 256 with white to white: a scattered place along one colour is still that colour, so this is FX-GRAD-013.

FX-GRAD-016.says: Start opacity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRAD-017.says: End opacity -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRAD-018.says: End opacity keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRAD-019.says: Start point 1001, 0, past ten widths. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRAD-020.says: Shape "conic", which is not a shape. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRAD-021.says: Blend "overlay", which is not a blend. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRAD-022.says: A start colour written "#12345", one digit short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRAD-030.says: Ramp Scatter 257, above 256. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRAD-031.says: Blend With Original 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRAD-032.says: Blend With Original keyed to -1 at frame 4, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
